content.title:
Cancer is a disease in which some of the body’s cells grow uncontrollably and may spread to other parts of the body. 

Normally, human cells grow and multiply to form new cells as the body needs them. Sometimes this process breaks down, and abnormal or damaged cells grow and multiply when they shouldn’t. https://go.usa.gov/xekC3 #NothingWillStopUs | National Cancer Institute | Facebook
